title: pvFiniteElementFieldDistributor
body:
## pvFiniteElementFieldDistributor

Turns element-wise finite-element coefficients into point fields for visualization: it duplicates points so each element owns its own nodes, promotes cells to higher-order Lagrange types where needed, and evaluates H(Grad) discontinuous-Galerkin scalars and H(Curl)/H(Div) vector fields at those nodes. Input must be a partitioned dataset collection whose field data has an "Information Records" string array describing bases and fields (Intrepid2 conventions, e.g. Exodus files read with the IOSS reader); the output has the same structure with the distributed point arrays.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Without a valid Information Records array the filter fails; ordinary meshes are not suitable.
- Pyramid elements are not supported, and the duplicated points make the output larger than the input.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `FiniteElementFieldDistributor`. Identity: `filters/FiniteElementFieldDistributor`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Finite Element Field Distributor filter. The input dataset must have an Information Records string array in the field data. Accepted data: partitioned dataset collections (vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

